title: Aphorism § 171
text:
§ 171  Sixth Edition



In non-venereal chronic disease, those, therefore, that arise from
          psora, we often require, in order to effect a cure, to give several antipsoric remedies in
          succession, every successive one being homoeopathically chosen in consonance with the
          group of symptoms remaining after completion of the action of the previous remedy.
